title: Winkelapparaat en ruimtelijk koopgedrag in Uithoorn 1969
authors: Dieleman, F.M., Heins, J.J.F., Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam * Amsterdam, Geografisch en planologisch instituut (primary investigator)
descriptions: Buying patterns of consumption goods grocery, butcher, dairy products, vegetables etc. / in terms of district, street-corner / outside the town / branches of shops in the district. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ housing situation/ household characteristics/ place of work/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ consumption of durables
